title: The Art of Treating Children
subtitle: Sami & Mina are counting on you
synopsis:
Welcome, Doctor! 🧒🦷

Sami is an impatient dentist: 'A loose baby tooth? Let's extract it! A crying child? Calm them down!' Mina, more pedagogical, holds him back: 'Not so fast, Sami! Every baby tooth is important for the child's future.'

Between early childhood caries, a fractured tooth, a sucking habit, or a developing malocclusion, pedodontics is a true art.

A brusque gesture, an awkward word, and the child carries a fear of the dentist for life. A gentle approach, an adapted explanation, and the child becomes a cooperative patient.

The dental health of children, their confidence, their smile for life rest on YOUR shoulders.

chapters.debutant1: Welcome, Doctor! Sami is impatient: 'A loose baby tooth? Let's extract it!' Mina holds him back: 'Not so fast!' Discover the basics of pedodontics: dental development, eruption, caries, prevention.
chapters.debutant2: Sami and Mina delve into pediatric care: trauma, congenital pathologies, eruption anomalies, therapeutic approaches adapted to children.
chapters.intermediaire1: Sami and Mina master pediatric care: development, eruption, prevention, restorations. They learn to treat children with gentleness and efficiency.
chapters.intermediaire2: Sami and Mina tackle emergencies and complex pathologies: trauma, impacted teeth, congenital pathologies. Pedodontics is put to the test.
chapters.expert1: Sami and Mina become references in pedodontics. They train young dentists in the art of treating children and early prevention.
chapters.expert2: After years of practice, Sami and Mina leave a legacy of pediatric skills. Pedodontics is the art of building tomorrow's smile.
